test_title: PYST 19: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 05 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F, and G are sitting in a row, facing the north. Only one person sits to the right of E. Only three people sit between G and E. Only three people sit between A and D, neither of whom sits on the left end. F sits immediately to the right of C. Only one person sits between A and B. Who sits second to the left of C?
solution:
**Given:** Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F, and G are sitting in a row, facing the north.

1. Only one person sits to the right of E.

2. Only three people sit between G and E.

3. Only three people sit between A and D, neither of whom sits on the left end.

4. F sits immediately to the right of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f3f7c3cf3c8f6d65732982573ae3db83a056eed8a2148f623d4d785587bacef.png] 

5. Only one person sits between A and B.

The above statement cannot be satisfied in case II, so it is eliminated.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ec673e9d79b672d89620c482fa277bdc590169203f11a9100d8230f61551f133.png] 

Thus, G sits second to the left of C.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
